hero.headline: Building clean, purposeful websites and web applications.
hero.supportingText: Hi, I'm Aya. I develop tailored WordPress websites and custom MERN web applications. With a background in accounting, I combine analytical thinking with practical development to build solutions that actually serve your business.

interactive.codeComment: // Turning business requirements into working code
interactive.triggerPrompt: Click the steps to see the development progression

story.scene1_headline: Every great website begins with an idea.
story.scene1_sub: A clear understanding of what a business needs and what its users are looking for.
story.scene2_sub: Breaking down requirements into structured plans, data models, and organized workflows.
story.scene3_sub: Pages, layouts, navigation, and user interactions come together cleanly.
story.scene4_headline: The code becomes a working website.
story.scene4_sub: A fast, responsive, and easy-to-use digital tool ready for real visitors.
story.final_statement_sub: Clean code, honest communication, and attention to detail.

about.badgeMain: MY STORY // FROM NUMBERS TO CODE
about.scene1_headline: Before the code, there were numbers.
about.scene1_sub: My journey began in accounting, where I learned to look beyond numbers, understand how businesses work, and find clarity in complex details.
about.scene2_headline: Then I discovered another way to build solutions.
about.scene2_sub: Programming opened a new world where analytical thinking could meet creativity.
about.scene3_sub: I discovered that development is not only about writing code. It's about understanding a problem and creating something useful, thoughtful, and intuitive.
about.scene4_sub: A deliberate evolution from financial systems into modern digital craft.
about.scene5_headline: What I bring to every project.
about.principle1_desc: Technology works best when it solves the right problem.
about.principle2_desc: Every decision should make the experience clearer and more useful.
about.principle3_desc: A beautiful interface matters. So does everything behind it.
about.scene6_headline: My story is still being written.
about.scene6_sub: And some of my favorite chapters are the projects I've helped bring to life.
